claims.text: She attended the Farewell Party of Bilbo Baggins in with her family. When Bilbo disappeared, Master Rorimac attempted to calm her, saying that the "Mad Baggins" just left for another adventure.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Brandybuck of Buckland"; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Took of Great Smials"; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Fellowship of the Ring, "A Long-expected Party"

claims.text: Later Esmeralda herself became mistress of Buckland and of Brandy Hall. Her older brother Paladin Took II also became the Thain. Her son Meriadoc was cousin with the Thain's children, and especially close friends with his cousin Peregrin Took.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Took of Great Smials"; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Fellowship of the Ring, "The Shadow of the Past"
